name: Dip rotation, bigger bets on the deepest dips only (second sizing attempt)
written: 2026-11-10, after the first sizing test and before this one was run
attempt: 2 of 2. It was chosen after seeing the first test's table of results by dip depth, on the same older years. A second try is more likely to pass by luck than a first.
base_rule: rules/dip_rotation.json, unchanged: same 12 ETFs, same signal, same exit, same costs, max 3 positions, deepest drop first.
idea: Keep the normal size for shallow and medium dips. Bet one and a half units only on dips deeper than 4%. No borrowing: the account is never more than 100% invested.

units.size: one unit (one third of the account, the same as today)
one and a half units (half the account)

test: Equal-size and sized versions side by side on the older years only (2000-01-01 to 2014-12-31).
pass_mark: The sized version's yearly percent increase is higher than the equal-size version's.
The sized version's worst drop is not worse than the equal-size version's.
limits: The newer years (2015 on) were already used to judge the base rule, so they cannot fairly confirm a sizing change. Confirmation would have to come from paper trading forward. No third attempt on these years.
